remarks: Classic Connecticut! Welcome to this spacious 5 bedroom Connecticut home in New Canaan. Stunning pastoral and romantic scenery, stone walls, and stunning heritage trees throughout your private 2 acre property on Cul-de-sac Street. The beautiful and historic Selleck's Chapel is right around the corner. Enjoy your very own post-and-beam detached barn which offers a two-car garage additional flex space, and a loft inside. Inground gunite pool with cabana and patio receive direct sunlight, allowing for fantastic entertaining flow. It's a 7 minute picturesque drive to town on Oenoke Ridge. Brought up to today's standards with new solar panels paid in full, EV charger and a house generator. Guests approach through a circular driveway, with an additional driveway leading to the gorgeous barn for everyday living and mudroom access. This center hall colonial features a gourmet kitchen adjacent to a family room with a fireplace, vaulted ceilings and natural light. Large dining room and living room with wood burning fireplace, lead into an office or bonus room featuring exquisite antique barn floors and vaulted ceilings. 500 ADDITIONAL square feet in lower level! That has a private guest suite with full bath, large laundry room, and playroom or gym. Primary bedroom with ensuite bath on the second floor has balcony overlooking the property grounds perfect for sunsets or morning coffee. 3 additional bedrooms round out the second floor with a shared, renovated bath. Welcome to New Canaan!
